findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "careers_list_roles" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List NimbleBrain's open roles and how to apply. Call this first whenever someone wants to apply to NimbleBrain or asks what NimbleBrain is hiring for, before ca…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: careers_submit_application · Public sink: careers_submit_application.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: careers_submit_application · Public sink: careers_submit_application

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
